mission: Escapement converts available agent capacity plus delegated authority into verified, delivered outcomes while reserving human attention for consequential choices.
short_description: The control system for agentic delivery. Delegate outcomes. Get verified delivery.

product_interface.long_description: Delegate a bounded outcome. Escapement structures the work, allocates isolated execution, challenges the oracle, keeps reversible work moving, and follows the repository's authorized delivery path. Current host limitations stay explicit.
starter_prompts: Help me turn this bounded outcome into verified delivery.
Show me what work is ready in this repo.
Which Escapement capabilities and limits are active in this session?

principles: Delegating an outcome delegates its ordinary means
